import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst, cap, rev;
        long cost;
        Edge(int s, int d, int c, long co, int r) {
            src = s; dst = d; cap = c; cost = co; rev = r;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        int n;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> adj;
        int[] supp;
        long[] ptnl;
        long minCost, totalCost;

        MinCostFlow(int _n) {
            n = _n;
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            supp = new int[n];
            ptnl = new long[n];
            minCost = 0;
            totalCost = 0;
        }

        void add_edge(int src, int dst, int cap, long cost) {
            if (cap <= 0) return;
            if (cost < 0) {
                supp[src] -= cap;
                supp[dst] += cap;
                minCost += cap * cost;
                totalCost -= cap * cost; // totalCost increases by -cost*cap
                adj.get(dst).add(new Edge(dst, src, cap, -cost, adj.get(src).size()));
                adj.get(src).add(new Edge(src, dst, 0, cost, adj.get(dst).size() - 1));
            } else {
                totalCost += cap * cost;
                adj.get(src).add(new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost, adj.get(dst).size()));
                adj.get(dst).add(new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost, adj.get(src).size() - 1));
            }
        }

        void supply(int node, int vol) {
            supp[node] += vol;
        }

        boolean flow() {
            long infty = totalCost + 1;
            boolean aug;
            do {
                aug = false;
                int[] last = new int[n];
                Arrays.fill(last, -1);
                long[] dist = new long[n];
                Arrays.fill(dist, infty);
                PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
                for (int node = 0; node < n; node++) {
                    if (supp[node] > 0) {
                        dist[node] = 0;
                        pq.offer(new long[]{0, node});
                    }
                }
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] top = pq.poll();
                    long d = top[0];
                    int node = (int) top[1];
                    if (d != dist[node]) continue;
                    ptnl[node] -= d;
                    if (ptnl[node] > infty) ptnl[node] = infty;
                    dist[node] = infty;
                    ArrayList<Edge> list = adj.get(node);
                    for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = list.get(i);
                        if (e.cap == 0) continue;
                        long nd = ptnl[node] + e.cost - ptnl[e.dst];
                        if (nd < dist[e.dst]) {
                            dist[e.dst] = nd;
                            last[e.dst] = i;
                            pq.offer(new long[]{nd, e.dst});
                        }
                    }
                }
                boolean[] shut = new boolean[n];
                for (int dst = 0; dst < n; dst++) {
                    if (supp[dst] < 0 && last[dst] != -1) {
                        int resid = -supp[dst];
                        int src = dst;
                        int block = -1;
                        while (last[src] != -1 && !shut[src]) {
                            Edge e = adj.get(src).get(last[src]);
                            if (resid >= e.cap) {
                                resid = e.cap;
                                block = src;
                            }
                            src = e.src;
                        }
                        if (shut[src]) {
                            block = src;
                        } else {
                            if (resid >= supp[src]) {
                                resid = supp[src];
                                block = src;
                            }
                            for (int node = dst; node != src; ) {
                                Edge e = adj.get(node).get(last[node]);
                                e.cap -= resid;
                                Edge rev = adj.get(e.dst).get(e.rev);
                                rev.cap += resid;
                                node = e.src;
                            }
                            supp[src] -= resid;
                            supp[dst] += resid;
                            minCost += ptnl[dst] * resid;
                            aug = true;
                        }
                        if (block != -1) {
                            for (int node = dst; node != block; ) {
                                shut[node] = true;
                                Edge e = adj.get(node).get(last[node]);
                                node = e.src;
                            }
                            shut[block] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } while (aug);
            for (int s : supp) if (s > 0) return false;
            return true;
        }

        long optimal() {
            return flow() ? minCost : -1;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        final int tlim = 105;
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(6100);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            mcf.supply(j, 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    long cost = c + d * (x * 2L + 1);
                    mcf.add_edge(u, nv, 1, cost);
                    mcf.add_edge(v, nu, 1, cost);
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.add_edge(n * t + i, n * (t + 1) + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        int dst = mcf.n - 1;
        mcf.supply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; t++) {
            mcf.add_edge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(mcf.optimal());
        sc.close();
    }
}
